name: Zando'zan

meta.previous: To Orgrimmar! or Find the Shattered Hand

summary: In Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, Shenthul sends a promising rogue to meet Zando'zan. There, training begins for the Shattered Hand's covert ranks.

sections.title: A Walk into the Shadows
sections.body: Orgrimmar's rulers know strength alone cannot win every war. Beneath the city, the Cleft of Shadow is home to the Shattered Hand, a covert guild serving the Horde through espionage, sabotage, and theft. When rogue trainer Shenthul sees promise in an initiate, he sends them to Zando'zan for training as an operative.

sections.title: Proving One's Worth
sections.body: Zando'zan tests each inexperienced rogue who enters the cavern before granting respect. Meeting him begins formal training in stealth, subterfuge, and thievery. His lessons bridge the gap between rough street cutpurses and organized intelligence operatives. From there, rogues prepare for fieldwork beyond the safety of the capital's red canyon walls.

faq.answer: Zando'zan trains rogues and handles recruits for the Shattered Hand in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow. He tests new arrivals and teaches stealth, burglary, and the work of an operative.

faq.q: Why does Shenthul send rogues to see Zando'zan?
aliases: why do i talk to zando'zan
faq.answer: Shenthul sends promising rogues to Zando'zan for specialized Shattered Hand training. Zando'zan teaches burglary and lock manipulation for covert fieldwork.

faq.q: What is the Shattered Hand in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: The Shattered Hand began as a brutal orcish clan from Draenor, known for ritual self-mutilation. It became the Horde's covert arm for intelligence and assassination. From Orgrimmar's shadows, its members practice espionage, poison, and scouting.

faq.q: Where does this training chain lead next?
faq.answer: After you report to Zando'zan, he sends you to Ratchet on the Barrens coast. There, you consult Wrenix, a goblin contact, and begin practical lockpicking fieldwork.
Zando'zan works in the Cleft of Shadow, a cavern network deep beneath Orgrimmar's center. Warlocks, shadow priests, and rogue operatives gather there, away from broad daylight.

faq.q: Why does Zando'zan apologize upon meeting me?
faq.answer: Zando'zan may have doubted your nerve before you arrived. Seeing you ready to train, he acknowledges your commitment and withdraws his initial doubt.

angles.text: As a rogue, you enter the Shattered Hand's covert ranks. You begin as an untrained knifefighter and train to become a recognized Horde operative.
The Shattered Hand carries out the Horde's espionage and covert work, guarding against threats hidden from view. The warchief speaks of honor and frontal assault.
